payload.core_mechanism_summary: Exhaustively enumerate pairs (m,n) with 1<=n<=m<=sqrt(n), check primitive condition (coprime and opposite parity), then count multiples m^2+n^2 up to n.
payload.rationale: The code uses nested loops to brute-force all possible (m,n) generating primitive triples, a classic complete search. No recursion, but closest to backtracking among given subtypes.
